YTXTube, a YouTube and YouTube Music client, comes with the open-source build: it installs once from Extra apps and then opens from the home screen with its own icon (no Shorts, no AMOLED theme, updated with Pulse). Also: photo tools in the Toolkit (ASCII art, halftone QR, tilt-shift) and effects in the Photos editor, reading statistics, RSVP speed reading and free classics in the book reader, eye-comfort reader themes, PDF text search, a floating ink bar in Notes, smarter keyboard suggestions (your name and e-mail from their first letters, a saved-login prompt), shuffle and repeat modes for every music player, and many fixes.
